name: Rutsu Rutsu Gardening Club!
source:
Taki is an 18-year-old boy who recently moved to Collage Rootsfall. One day, he ends up choosing a club and meets a girl who proposes him the gardening club, giving him an appointment at the greenhouse the next day. Will this be the beginning of a big love and plot twists? Find out by playing Rūtsu - rūtsu - Gardening Club. Visual Novel created especially for garden lovers.

[From [url=https://xenochronic.itch.io/rutsu-rutsu-gardening-club]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Taki是一名18岁男孩，最近搬到了Collage Rootsfall。有一天，他最终选择了一个俱乐部，并遇到了一位女孩，她向他推荐了园艺俱乐部，并给了他第二天在温室的约会。这会是一场大爱情和曲折情节的开始吗？通过玩Rūtsu - rūtsu - 园艺俱乐部来找出答案。专为花园爱好者创作的视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://xenochronic.itch.io/rutsu-rutsu-gardening-club]Itch.io[/url]]
